values.description: The API root. Change the port here if PORT in .env is not 3000.

The same server under a different host name. Cookies are scoped to a host name, so Postman's jar attaches nothing here; two failure paths use it to show the guard with no cookie at all. Keep the port in step with baseUrl.
Mailpit's HTTP API, the port docker-compose.yml publishes. The auth collection's pre-request script reads the emailed tokens from it.
The account all three collections act on. Create user (users) registers it and Login (auth) verifies against it, so they can never drift apart.
12 to 128 characters, no composition rules. The value here is the password at registration; Change password and Reset password rewrite the current value to newPassword.
The replacement used by Change password and Reset password.
Set by the auth collection's pre-request script from the newest verification email in Mailpit, just before Verify email runs. Never travels over HTTP.
Set by the auth collection's pre-request script from the newest reset email in Mailpit, just before Reset password runs. Never travels over HTTP.
Set by Create product in the products collection. Place order in the orders collection reads it, which is why it lives here rather than in either collection.
